# Decorations

Decorative greebles for mappers to put on ship and station hulls: radar dishes, poles, external tanks, a glowing
radiator, hull panels and antennas. They have no function; place them from the spawn menu (search `WFGreeble`).
All are prototypes in `greebles.yml`, parented to Mono's `BaseGreeble`.
